audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer (which matches the packet) on all seven rows.
audit.why: Even 1-2, Zoe's E-into-charged-Q one-shot owns 3-5, then 6 onward is strongly Malzahar's: point-click suppress ignores her blinks, his CC-immune passive stops the bubble cancelling his channel, and waveclear frees his roam. 58.12% WR over 2082 games backs the Malzahar-favoured back half.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content win[]; whys rewritten per row.

audit.why: Spikes: her 3-5 one-shot window, his 6 flip, first-item roam tempo, late engage-beats-poke — spikes[0..3] state all four with counterplay. suspectName 'Paddle Star' vs 'Paddle Star!' is punctuation only.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 misgendered fields (Zoe is she/her), no digit in breakdown.cooldowns, two copy-paste-bleed bullets, and three applicable missing interactions: sleep reduces MR and doubles the wake-up hit (stacking resists is not the answer), her E can cancel Nether Grasp's channel (only when the passive's CC immunity is down), and More Sparkles! auto-reset is the combo tell.
audit.why: Her E is 18s rank 1 / 14s max — the single cooldown the lane runs on; her R blink is only 575 range and does not break suppression. All folded in at same length.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere, cooldown numbers added, bleed bullets replaced with bubble/silence sequencing, missing interactions placed in cooldowns and don'ts.
